component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.tvGuide = m.top.findNode("tvGuide") m.errorStaticVideo = m.top.findNode("errorStaticVideo") m.videoComponent = m.top.findNode("videoComponent") m.catalogTask = m.top.findNode("catalogTask") m.playlistTask = m.top.findNode("playlistTask")
m.loadingDialog = invalid m.errorDialog = invalid
m.tvGuide.observeField("channelSelected", "onChannelSelected") m.catalogTask.observeField("catalog", "onCatalogLoaded") m.catalogTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onCatalogError") m.playlistTask.observeField("playlist", "onPlaylistLoaded") m.playlistTask.observeField("errorMessage", "onPlaylistError") m.videoComponent.observeField("playbackEnded", "onPlaybackEnded")
showLoading("Loading TV guide...") appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") m.catalogTask.uri = appInfo.getValue("channel_catalog_url") catalogTimeout = 0 catalogTimeoutValue = appInfo.getValue("channel_catalog_timeout_seconds") if catalogTimeoutValue <> invalid and catalogTimeoutValue <> "" catalogTimeout = catalogTimeoutValue.toInt() end if if catalogTimeout <= 0 then catalogTimeout = 10 m.catalogTask.timeoutSeconds = catalogTimeout m.catalogTask.control = "run" end sub
sub onCatalogLoaded(event as object) catalog = event.getData() if catalog = invalid then return closeLoading() m.tvGuide.content = catalog m.tvGuide.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onCatalogError(event as object) message = event.getData() if message <> "" then showApiError(message) end sub
sub onChannelSelected(event as object) index = event.getData() if m.tvGuide.content = invalid then return channel = m.tvGuide.content.getChild(index) if channel = invalid then return
status = channel.status.lcase() if status = "offline" or status = "inactive" or status = "disabled" showError(channel.title + " is currently " + channel.status + ".") return end if
m.selectedChannel = channel showLoading("Loading " + channel.title + "...") m.playlistTask.control = "stop" m.playlistTask.uri = channel.playlistUrl m.playlistTask.playlistType = channel.playlistType m.playlistTask.resolverUri = channel.url m.playlistTask.control = "run" end sub
sub onPlaylistLoaded(event as object) playlist = event.getData() if playlist = invalid or m.selectedChannel = invalid then return closeLoading() m.tvGuide.visible = false m.videoComponent.visible = true if m.selectedChannel.playlistType = "server-random" m.videoComponent.startIndex = 0 else m.videoComponent.startIndex = m.selectedChannel.currentIndex end if m.videoComponent.channelTitle = m.selectedChannel.title m.videoComponent.playlist = playlist m.videoComponent.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onPlaylistError(event as object) message = event.getData() if message <> "" then showApiError(message) end sub
sub onPlaybackEnded() m.videoComponent.visible = false m.tvGuide.visible = true m.tvGuide.setFocus(true) end sub
sub showLoading(title as string) m.loadingDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "ProgressDialog") m.loadingDialog.title = title m.top.dialog = m.loadingDialog end sub
sub closeLoading() if m.loadingDialog <> invalid then m.loadingDialog.close = true m.loadingDialog = invalid end sub
sub showError(message as string) m.loadingDialog = invalid m.errorDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.errorDialog.title = "TV Guide Error" m.errorDialog.buttons = [ "OK" ] m.errorDialog.message = message m.errorDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onErrorButtonSelected") m.errorDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onErrorClosed") m.top.dialog = m.errorDialog end sub
sub showApiError(message as string) staticContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") staticContent.url = "pkg:/tvstatic2p.mp4" staticContent.title = "TV static" staticContent.streamFormat = "mp4"
m.tvGuide.visible = false m.videoComponent.visible = false m.errorStaticVideo.visible = true m.errorStaticVideo.content = staticContent m.errorStaticVideo.control = "play" showError(message) end sub
sub onErrorButtonSelected() if m.errorDialog <> invalid then m.errorDialog.close = true end sub
sub onErrorClosed() m.errorDialog = invalid if m.errorStaticVideo.visible m.errorStaticVideo.control = "stop" m.errorStaticVideo.visible = false m.tvGuide.visible = true end if if m.videoComponent.visible m.videoComponent.setFocus(true) else m.tvGuide.setFocus(true) end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.tvGuide.visible and not m.videoComponent.visible return false end if return false end function
